program.section_heading: MEDIA ARTS: EDITING AND COLOR GRADING
outcomes: Students will learn about the aesthetics of film and media and be able to apply that knowledge to productions.
Students will be able to gain experience using various editorial and color techniques and styles to effectively tell a story.
Students will be able to successfully accomplish the tasks of all positions on the editing and color grading team

Students will be able to have the ability to build a reel (digital resume) with their own footage in order to better position themselves for transfer and/or gainful employment in the entertainment industry.

notes: The required-courses heading says '5 REQUIRED COURSES' but lists 6 courses (CINEMA 105, CINEMA 107, MEDIART 100, MEDIART 116, MEDIART 121, MEDIART 122); the printed Major Units of 24 matches 6 required courses plus one from List A and one from List B, so all 6 were recorded as required.
'Total Minimum Units: 60' is printed beneath this award's major units and was recorded as degree_total; no GE pattern or GE units are named in this section.
Asterisks on course codes (prerequisite/corequisite markers) were dropped from the codes.
Outcome 4 mentions 'gainful employment in the entertainment industry', but no careers are named in the program description, so careers were left empty.
